full.description: This image shows a gross specimen of a spleen cut in half, displayed against a blue background. The dark red-brown parenchymal surfaces reveal pale, yellowish wedge-shaped areas near the margins. These findings are characteristic of splenic infarctions, likely due to embolic events from sources such as nonbacterial endocarditis.
